title: Strawberries Are Not Berries
description:
To a botanist, a berry is a fleshy fruit that grows from the ovary of a single flower and has seeds inside. By that definition grapes, tomatoes, eggplants and bananas are berries, while strawberries, raspberries and blackberries are aggregate fruits and mulberries are multiple fruits. In the kitchen, though, strawberries are still called berries.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Berry' (botanical vs culinary definition).
